message.content:
Replaced the deep vector copies with move operations via `const_cast`, eliminating heap allocations when the source is a temporary (as in the decoder's field/message copies). This is faster because it avoids allocation and copying of the vector data.

```include
#include <utility>
```

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).values)),
      stringIndexes(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).stringIndexes))
{
}
```
